review_scope: Read-only mathematical/dataflow review; no new research cohorts, nuisance fits or policy selection performed
resolved_findings: true two-peak sin4pi and derivative amended before sampling
full retained spline fit/query failure explicitly saved without redraw
mesh observed extrema checked for any nonzero spline weight; pureLL query avoids spline
CV common support mask is specified before sampling; individual omitted amounts do not themselves trigger fallback; under20events/15users or fit/density fold failure does
leakage_review: Outer validation users absent from all T nuisance fits, T crossfits and T curves; validationY enters only external pseudo-outcome residual and CV score. Scaling fits use onlyT. Nested code does not read generator truth, seed-specific rules or old results.
units_and_objective: All pseudo-outcomes and curves remain seconds; analytic rawalpha is spline weight, effectivealpha=1-gamma*(1-rawalpha). CV uses equal-event observed-dose level risk on declared common support, distinct from uniform-grid contrast RMSE used for global development gamma/beta selection.
common_final_fit: Study uses one cached full-cohort xi, fitted spline and LL2 for every final convex policy, without clipping or monotonicity.
scientific_limits: CV optimizes an imperfect level-risk proxy, so improvement in reference contrasts is a hypothesis to test on untouched confirmation
Support filtering depends on X,D and density diagnostics, notY; resulting validation population is the common supported subset
12 independent confirmation seed blocks, paired mechanisms within each; simulated related mechanism family, no field validation
